status_vocabulary.DELIVERED_ON_MAIN: not used: nothing is delivered until per-field binding is proven; capability-level presence is recorded as delivery_note on PLANNED_NUMBERED operands
status_vocabulary.PLANNED_NUMBERED: a numbered story owns the operand in the public routes; includes closed baseline stories whose reuse is unproved
status_vocabulary.PROPOSED_NEW_STORY: a new story proposed in EQ164_WAVE2_DECISIONS.md; none is needed by this half
status_vocabulary.UNCOVERED_GAP: no numbered, delivered or proposed owner

resolution_classes.RESOLVED_ALL_OPERANDS_COVERED: every named operand has a delivered, planned or proposed owner; residual selection questions remain and are listed
resolution_classes.RESOLVED_WITH_GAPS: operands named; at least one has no owner (listed as operand_gaps)
resolution_classes.STILL_AMBIGUOUS: operand set cannot be named; the missing evidence is stated
